subject: Renewal: capacity top-up — invoice delegate & EIN checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmetech.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeTech Billing <billing@acmetech.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal top-up — invoice recipient & EIN

Hi Chloe / Vivek,

We're finalizing the renewal + capacity top-up for AcmeTech (RDW-2027-87412). A couple of billing items before procurement issues the PO: 

1) We need the invoice to be sent to our procurement mailbox (billing@acmetech.com) and also copy Marco Ruiz (finance lead) on the invoice documents.
2) Our AP team requires a clear EIN on the invoice and a stub confirming Redwood's tax ID — can you attach that?
3) PO will reference the new term (36-month commitment) and include the top-up quantity — we'll share the PO number once signed.

Can your billing/finance team confirm they can add the EIN field and send the invoice to billing@acmetech.com when the PO is uploaded? We prefer the invoice be split as a single line item with the top-up amount but with the legal entity and EIN included.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Procurement, AcmeTech

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmetech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal top-up — invoice recipient & EIN

Samantha — thanks for the heads up. Short answers below and next steps.

- We can populate Redwood's tax ID/EIN and include it as a distinct field on the invoice PDF. Monica from Finance is on copy to confirm the format.
- We can send the invoice to billing@acmetech.com and cc Marco; please confirm Marco's preferred email (is m.ruiz@acmetech.com correct?).
- Once you upload the PO we will generate the invoice with the 36-month term and the top-up line. If your PO number differs per legal entity, please indicate which legal name/EIN pair we should quote on the invoice.

Action items:
- Monica: I can hand this to you to validate the invoice template and attach Redwood's EIN stub.
- Ben: can you confirm the exact top-up SKU and pricing to seed the invoice?

I'll follow up once Monica confirms the attachment.

Best,
Chloe
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmetech.com>, AcmeTech Billing <billing@acmetech.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal top-up — invoice recipient & EIN

Chloe / team / Samantha — putting this on record from Finance: 

- Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; EIN: 12-3456789. I attached a one-page EIN verification stub for AcmeTech's AP team.
- We can customize the invoice with a dedicated "Vendor EIN" field and an explicit "Bill-to legal entity" line.
- If AcmeTech needs the invoice split across two internal payors, we need the following from Samantha: the two legal entity names, corresponding EINs, and an allocation (e.g., 70% / 30%) or the exact amounts per entity.

Attachment: AcmeTech_EIN_Verification.pdf (Redwood stub).

Once we have the signed PO number we will generate the final invoice (PDF) and send to billing@acmetech.com and cc Marco Ruiz. If a DocuSign link is preferred for email-signing of the invoice or the amendment, we can also provide that.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmetech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmetech.com>, AcmeTech Billing <billing@acmetech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal top-up — invoice recipient & EIN

Hi Monica / Chloe — thanks, the stub is perfect. Quick clarifications: 

- Marco's email is correct (m.ruiz@acmetech.com).
- We will not split the invoice across two legal entities — the top-up should be billed to AcmeTech, Inc. (EIN: 98-7654321) as a single invoice. We will later allocate internally; no need to split now.
- PO will be issued next week and will include the PO number and a short reference to the 36-month term.

Please proceed to prepare a draft invoice so I can confirm layout with AP and Marco. If you can include a separate line in the PDF that reads: "Vendor EIN: 12-3456789 | Vendor Legal Name: Redwood Inference, Inc.", that will satisfy our audit.

Best,
Samantha

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmetech.com>, AcmeTech Billing <billing@acmetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Final: invoice draft & PO instructions (RDW-2027-87412)

Samantha / Marco / Billing team — attached is the draft invoice and the PO instructions. Key details: 

- Invoice will be sent to billing@acmetech.com and cc'd to m.ruiz@acmetech.com.
- Vendor line added: "Vendor Legal Name: Redwood Inference, Inc. | Vendor EIN: 12-3456789" — visible on the first page and in invoice metadata.
- Term & description: "36-month renewal + 2.5k token capacity top-up" with the agreed SKU and unit price (Ben confirmed pricing).
- When you upload/return the signed PO, please include the PO number in the subject line of your email (e.g., PO-87412) and attach the signed PDF. We will then finalize and send the official VAT/exempt invoice.

Attachments: PO-87412_AcmeTech.pdf (placeholder for signed PO), Topup-Order-Summary.xlsx (pricing breakout), AcmeTech_EIN_Verification.pdf (Redwood stub).

Next steps:
- AcmeTech: send signed PO to billing@redwood.com with PO number in subject.
- Redwood Finance: upon receipt, Monica will finalize invoice and route to accounting for records.

Thanks everyone — closing loop once we have the PO.

Best regards,
Chloe Martin
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
